newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada considers letting Bell broadcast.
newsitem.headline: Canada considers letting Bell broadcast.

text.p: The Canadian House of Commons on Monday debated legislation which would allow BCE Inc's Bell Canada to get into the broadcasting business.
The bill would lift a ban on the phone company from holding a broadcast license or operating a broadcast undertaking.

The legislation is now at the report stage, which follows committee consideration. The next and final stage in the House, Parliament's elected chamber, is the third reading, after which it would go to the unelected Senate.
The opposition Reform Party welcomed the bill but said it was only a small step towards increasing competition.
